final: WITH order_fills AS (SELECT o.orderspivot, o.recordvault AS ordersmark, o.timespan, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orders AS o JOIN orderexecutions AS e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderspivot, o.recordvault, o.timespan), compared AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, AVG(avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS tif_avg_fill FROM order_fills), ranked AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, avg_fill - tif_avg_fill AS excess_fill, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank FROM compared WHERE avg_fill > tif_avg_fill) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, excess_fill, fill_rank FROM ranked WHERE fill_rank <= 3
